- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:566-576 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The boolean guard is missing from `_validate_positive_int_field`, so `bool` values can be accepted as integers.
  WHY: In Python, `bool` is a subclass of `int`, so positive-integer fields can silently accept `True`/`False` and corrupt validation or database logic.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:80-92 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_require_positive_int` can still leak a raw `ValueError` from `_safe_int` instead of converting it to `MemoryValidationError`.
  WHY: Invalid numeric input would bypass the expected fail-open validation path and propagate as an uncaught exception.
- tests/test_family_node_runtime.py:40-60 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_run_renderer` and `_run_validation_lint` call `subprocess.run` without a timeout.
  WHY: A hung renderer or lint process can block the test indefinitely and cause CI to time out.
- tests/test_family_node_runtime.py:64-67,139-142 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Both tests unconditionally rely on `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory`, so CI can fail before assertions run if no usable temp directory is available.
  WHY: The test aborts with "No usable temporary directory found" in environments where `/tmp` or `TMPDIR` is unavailable or permission-restricted.
- tests/test_family_node_runtime.py:112-135,156-165 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The assertions are brittle to small renderer or template changes.
  WHY: Valid renders can fail the test on harmless whitespace or key-order differences, even when the harness invariants still hold.
- tests/test_family_node_runtime.py:179-195 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `main()` only catches `AssertionError`, so renderer/lint/YAML errors propagate as unhandled exceptions.
  WHY: A non-assertion failure turns the script into a hard CI failure with poor diagnostics instead of the intended test-style failure path.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:last_run_diff | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run introduced unrelated AI-memory and label changes outside the issue's bootstrap/test/documentation scope.
